intent: Individually authored recipient, learner-group, object-reference and ownership tasks, with original draft transfer. Guided practice only; no independent or hearing credit.
picturePurpose: Code draws four exactly identified bowls so learners select the two moving objects rather than their destination group. Original transparent bird art supplies a visible wing/body relationship; ownership labels, evidence regions and pronoun forms remain in code.

workshop.title: 动作落到谁，东西属于谁？
workshop.instruction: 点接收者、圈移动的碗、找物主，再选对宾格和所属形式。

items.label: him：盘子递给谁？
items.prompt: Ming says he passed the plate to Ben, a boy. Amy did not receive it. Tap the person meant by him.

wordDecision.prompt: Ming says he passed the plate to Ben, a boy. Amy did not receive it. Tap the person meant by him.

recordPaths.label: 动作的发出者与接收者

recordSelection.title: 点出盘子的接收者
recordSelection.prompt: Ming把盘子递给男孩Ben；Amy没有收到。
recordSelection.hint: I是Ming，him是Ben，不能把两人混在一起。
recordSelection.quote: I passed him the last clean plate.

items.material: I passed him the last clean plate.
items.reason: I是递盘子的Ming，him指收到盘子的男孩Ben，两人不能混淆。pass somebody something表示把某物递给某人；这里人作宾语，用him。可改写为I passed the plate to him；to后也用宾格。
items.hint: 先找接收者Ben，再用宾格him；不是he。

options.text: Ming, because I refers to the speaker.
options.reason: I确实指说话的Ming，但him指另一个人Ben。

options.text: Write I passed he the plate.
options.reason: passed后这里需要宾格him，不用主格he。

options.text: Ben, the boy who received the plate.
options.reason: 盘子明确递给男孩Ben；him是动作的接收者。

items.label: her：被感谢的是她
items.prompt: Ben and Leo visited Mia, a girl who welcomed them. Ben tells Amy: “We thanked her for the warm welcome.” Who is her?

wordDecision.prompt: Ben and Leo visited Mia, a girl who welcomed them. Ben tells Amy: “We thanked her for the warm welcome.” Who is her?

recordSelection.title: 点出被感谢的接待者
recordSelection.prompt: Ben和Leo来访，Mia欢迎他们；Ben在向Amy讲这件事。
recordSelection.hint: 找被thanked的人，不是说话者或听者。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选接待者Mia；Ben和Leo表达感谢，Amy在听。
recordSelection.quote: We thanked her for the warm welcome.

items.material: We thanked her for the warm welcome.
items.reason: We指Ben和Leo这两位访客，her指接待他们的女孩Mia。her在thanked后作宾语，表示她；在her welcome中，her放在名词前，表示她的。同一词形的作用要看位置，不能把这里的宾语改成she。
items.hint: thanked her：感谢她；her welcome：她的欢迎。

options.text: Mia, the girl who welcomed Ben and Leo.
options.reason: Mia接待了两位访客，所以被感谢的是她。

options.text: Ben, because he says We.
options.reason: Ben属于感谢别人的一方，不是这句话中被感谢的人。

options.text: Write We thanked she.
options.reason: thanked后的人是宾语，用her，不用she。

items.label: us：谁一起跟导游学？
items.prompt: Amy, Ming and Leo learned the signs from Ms Li, their guide. Amy says “The guide taught us how to read the signs.” Tap us.

wordDecision.prompt: Amy, Ming and Leo learned the signs from Ms Li, their guide. Amy says “The guide taught us how to read the signs.” Tap us.

recordSelection.title: 点出跟导游学习的所有人
recordSelection.prompt: Amy在说话，她也参加了这次学习。
recordSelection.hint: us包含Amy，但不把导游加进被教的小组。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Amy、Ming、Leo；漏掉Amy或加入导游都不对。
recordSelection.quote: The guide taught us how to read the signs.

items.material: The guide taught us how to read the signs.
items.reason: us是we的宾格。Amy在说自己和Ming、Leo跟导游学路标，taught后用us，包含说话者Amy，不包含导游Ms Li。换成主语时用we：We learned how to read the signs。不要写The guide taught we。
items.hint: taught us；us包含说话的Amy，排除教他们的导游。

options.text: Ming and Leo only.
options.reason: us是我们，不能漏掉也参加学习的说话者Amy。

options.text: Amy, Ming and Leo, the three learners.
options.reason: us指说话的Amy和一起学习的Ming、Leo，不含导游。

options.text: Ms Li and the three pupils.
options.reason: Ms Li是教的人，不属于原话中被教的us。

items.label: them：移的是这两个，不是旁边那两个
items.prompt: Blue bowls A and B must be moved beside white bowls C and D. Tap only the bowls meant by them.

wordDecision.prompt: Blue bowls A and B must be moved beside white bowls C and D. Tap only the bowls meant by them.

recordPaths.label: 把移动对象与参照物分开

recordSelection.title: 点出要搬动的两个碗
recordSelection.prompt: 蓝碗A、B要搬到白碗C、D旁边；只选移动对象。
recordSelection.hint: 颜色和字母一起核对；them不包括other bowls。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选蓝碗A、B；白碗C、D留在原处作参照。

items.material: Put them beside the other bowls.
items.reason: them代替前文已提到的复数对象，这里是要搬动的蓝碗A和B。other bowls指旁边的白碗C和D，两组作用不同。Put后用宾格them；they是主格，their表示他们的，不能替代这里的宾语。

options.text: White bowls C and D.
options.reason: C、D是放置地点旁边的other bowls，不是要搬动的them。

options.text: All four bowls.
options.reason: 把四个都选上，就混淆了被搬动的碗和作为参照的碗。

options.text: Blue bowls A and B.
options.reason: 前文要搬动的是A、B，them承接这两个碗。

items.label: my：谁在说“我的夹克”？
items.prompt: Leo owns the jacket in his sentence. He tells Amy: “My jacket has a small pocket inside.” Tap the owner.

wordDecision.prompt: Leo owns the jacket in his sentence. He tells Amy: “My jacket has a small pocket inside.” Tap the owner.

recordSelection.title: 点出my jacket的物主
recordSelection.prompt: Leo在谈自己的夹克；Amy只是听者。
recordSelection.hint: my指当前说话者的，不指听者的。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Leo；Amy在听，Ben的夹克不是原话这件。
recordSelection.quote: My jacket has a small pocket inside.

items.material: My jacket has a small pocket inside.
items.after: jacket has a small pocket inside.
items.reason: my表示我的，跟随当前说话者。Leo说My jacket，物主是Leo，不是听者Amy。my要与名词连用，如my jacket；单独表示我的那个用mine，如The jacket is mine。不能写Mine jacket。

options.text: Amy, because Leo is talking to her.
options.reason: 对Amy说话，不等于my指Amy的；my跟着说话者。

options.text: Leo, who is speaking about his own jacket.
options.reason: My出自Leo的口中，夹克属于Leo。

options.text: Use Mine jacket.
options.reason: 名词jacket前用my；mine可单独使用，不能直接写mine jacket。

items.label: your：两位听者各自的票
items.prompt: The guide speaks to Mia and Leo, who each have a ticket. Tap the people meant by your in the guide’s request.

wordDecision.prompt: The guide speaks to Mia and Leo, who each have a ticket. Tap the people meant by your in the guide’s request.

recordPaths.label: 两位听者，各保留自己的票

recordSelection.title: 点出需要保留自己票的听者
recordSelection.prompt: Mia和Leo各有一张票；导游在对两人提出请求。
recordSelection.hint: your可指多人；这里两位听者各保留自己的票。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Mia和Leo；不选导游，也不能漏掉一位听者。
recordSelection.quote: Please keep your ticket until you leave.

items.material: Please keep your ticket until you leave.
items.reason: your可以表示你的，也可以表示你们的；这里同时指Mia和Leo两位听者的。your ticket在这个请求中指各自手里的票，不表示两人共用一张。your后接名词ticket；you’re是you are的缩写，不能放在这里替代your。
items.hint: your ticket是你的票；you’re = you are。

options.text: Mia and Leo: each keeps their own ticket.
options.reason: 导游同时对Mia和Leo说，两人都要保留各自的票。

options.text: Only the guide keeps the guide’s ticket.
options.reason: your指听者的，不是说话导游自己的。

options.text: Replace your with you’re.
options.reason: you’re等于you are；keep you are ticket不成立。

items.label: his：后面没名词，也能表示“他的”
items.prompt: Mia points to Ben’s seat. Ben is a boy. Mia says “That seat is his, not mine.” Tap the seat’s owner.

wordDecision.prompt: Mia points to Ben’s seat. Ben is a boy. Mia says “That seat is his, not mine.” Tap the seat’s owner.

recordSelection.title: 点出That seat的物主
recordSelection.prompt: Mia指着Ben的座位说话；Ben是男孩。

rows.label: Mia
rows.text: Speaks; this seat is not hers.

recordSelection.hint: his承接Ben的，不把说话者当成物主。
recordSelection.wrong: 应选Ben；not mine已排除说话者Mia，Leo的座位是另一个。
recordSelection.quote: That seat is his, not mine.

items.material: That seat is his, not mine.
items.reason: 这里his单独表示他的，指Ben的座位，不再接名词。his也能放在名词前：his seat。两处词形相同；不要把That seat is his改成That seat is him。not mine说明这个座位不是说话者Mia的。
items.hint: his seat；The seat is his。him指人，不表示所属。

options.text: Mia: that is her own seat.
options.reason: not mine明确说不是说话者Mia自己的座位。

options.text: Replace his with him.
options.reason: him表示他这个人，不能表示他的座位。

options.text: Ben: that is his seat.
options.reason: that seat属于Ben；his在is后可单独表示他的。

items.label: its：翅膀属于它，不加撇号
items.prompt: Look at the bird and its attached wings. Choose who the wings belong to, then complete the sentence with the possessive form.

wordDecision.prompt: Look at the bird and its attached wings. Choose who the wings belong to, then complete the sentence with the possessive form.

recordSelection.title: 点出翅膀属于哪个整体
recordSelection.prompt: 图里两侧翅膀都连着同一只鸟；不要把阳光当成物主。

rows.label: Bird
rows.text: The wings are attached to it.

rows.label: Branch
rows.text: Not the owner of the wings.

recordSelection.hint: its在这里指鸟的；in the sun只补充环境。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Bird；翅膀属于鸟，不属于阳光或树枝。

art.alt: 一只小鸟张开两侧翅膀，翅膀与身体相连，两只脚清楚可见。

evidence.caption: 已选鸟。对照翅膀与身体的连接，再核对its的所属用法。
in the sun说明在阳光下；图中没有把太阳画成翅膀的物主。
it’s可展开成it is或it has；本句需要its + wings表示所属。

items.material: The bird spread its wings in the sun.
items.reason: its表示它的，放在名词wings前。图中翅膀连着这只鸟，所以its wings就是the bird’s wings。in the sun表示在阳光下，不改变物主。it’s带撇号，是it is或it has的缩写；替换成The bird spread it is wings就知道不对。
items.hint: its wings：它的翅膀；it’s不是所属形式。

options.text: The wings belong to the sun.
options.reason: in the sun说明在阳光下，不表示翅膀属于太阳。

options.text: The wings belong to the bird: its wings.
options.reason: 图中两侧翅膀连着同一只鸟；its表示这只鸟的。

options.text: Use it’s before wings to show ownership.
options.reason: it’s是it is或it has的缩写，不能在这里表示鸟的翅膀。

transfer.stem: Which set of notes correctly identifies the person thanked, the cup’s owner and the ticket holders?
transfer.passage:
AFTER THE CLUB VISIT
Ben writes: “Mia welcomed Leo and me to the club. We thanked her before leaving.”
He adds: “Mia gave me the last clean plate. I put it beside Leo’s cup. That cup is his.”
Their guide, Ms Li, told Ben and Leo, “Please keep your ticket until you leave.”

options.text: Her means Mia; the cup belongs to Leo; Ben and Leo each keep their own ticket.
Her means Leo; the cup belongs to Leo; Ben and Leo each keep their own ticket.
Her means Mia; the cup belongs to Ben; Ben and Leo each keep their own ticket.
Her means Mia; the cup belongs to Leo; only Ms Li keeps a ticket.

answer.display: Her means Mia; the cup belongs to Leo; Ben and Leo each keep their own ticket.

explanation.strategy: 分别找被感谢的人、物品的主人和请求面向的听者，不能把三种关系混成一组。

steps.text: Mia欢迎Ben和Leo，所以We thanked her中的her指Mia。杯子明确写成Leo’s cup，后面的his仍指Leo的。
steps.reason: her作thanked的宾语；his在is后独立表示所属。

steps.text: 导游Ms Li对Ben和Leo两人说your ticket，因此两位听者都保留各自的票。
steps.reason: your可以指多人；说话的导游不在这个请求指定的两位听者之内。

distractors.reason: Leo是被欢迎的访客之一；被感谢的接待者是Mia。
原文写明Leo’s cup，杯子不是Ben的；不要因为Ben正在写就把his都指向Ben。
请求同时面向Ben和Leo，your不是指说话导游自己的。

explanation.pitfall: 宾语找动作落到谁身上，所属找谁的，your还要找当前听者；三者不要混淆。

visual.title: 三种关系分别找线索

segments.note: 杯子的物主不随写作者改变

visual.caption: 代词形式要与宾语、所属和对话角色相匹配。

explanation.transfer: 若导游改为只对Ben说这句话，your指谁的票？若Leo把自己的杯子借给Ben，杯子的物主是否因此改变？
